app.name: Spareway
app.tagline: Fill the truck. Earn more per trip.
app.aboutText: Spareway helps small truck owners plan safe, full loads, pick the right route and find extra loads on the way — in English and Hindi.
app.missingEnvTitle: App is not set up yet
app.missingEnvText: This setting is missing: {{names}}. Add it to the .env file or the hosting settings and reload.
app.aboutTeam: Made by Team Bravo for the MU20 Hackathon 2026

aboutDoes.plan: Plans how to load the truck so goods fit safely and come out in stop order.
aboutDoes.route: Finds truck routes with full costs — diesel, tolls, driver and waiting.
aboutDoes.extra: Shows extra loads on the way that really add money, and why others don't fit.
aboutDoes.earn: Tells you what each trip earns.

owner.name: Truck owner
owner.text: Signs in, plans trips and shares links.

driver.name: Driver
driver.text: Opens the driver link: route, stops and times. No login.

loader.name: Loader
loader.text: Opens the loader link: box-by-box steps and a 3D view. No login.

provider.name: Load provider
provider.text: Opens a load link to give goods and price. No login.
